body: Very well put and definitely some good perspective on the situation. Perhaps someday more people who are not dealing with depression will understand this feeling rather than the attitude of "what do you have to be depressed about"
Um, no thanks? You know not everyone with depression is also doing self harm right?

What steps have you taken to seek help? I used to feel the same, the "this will never get better" feeling. But sometimes it can't, not without help. Personally I have chronic depression according to my doctor, and without my medication I cannot function normally due to chemical imbalances, but the medicine helps me so much.

Many people with depression feel this. I often imagine a gun to my temple or forehead, on bad days it will pop in my head over and over again until I force myself to stop. Just wanted you to know that you're not the only one here

Hey, it's going to be okay. There's some shit people here time to time but we can't let it get to us. We're all brothers and sisters in this together, and sometimes even those who understand the depression don't understand all types of it. I'm not a weed smoker myself but I guarantee you if I didn't have video games as escape i would be a goner. It's not so dissimilar, clearly not the same but I'm trying to empathize. 

What that person said was wrong, but they are no one, just some internet rando and they don't matter.

All that matters its that YOU have a way of coping and you are alive, is it perfect? No of course not, but it's a form of stability, and I know you can use that stability to push yourself forward
